detect_adsorbate_dissociation: use DetectTrajAnomaly to check if an adsorbate's initial connectivity is maintained after relaxation
detect_surface_reconstruction: use DetectTrajAnomaly to test if bond breaking or forming events occurred on the surface
detect_adsorbate_desorption: use DetectTrajAnomaly to check if adsorbate atoms have lost all connection to slab atoms
detect_adsorbate_intercalation: use DetectTrajAnomaly to check if any adsorbate atom neighbors a frozen bulk atom
get_connectivity_matrix: use DetectTrajAnomaly to generate a connectivity matrix for an ASE Atoms object
